subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

Will you give me an independent project?

options.text: Will you be given an independent project by me?
Would an independent project be given?
Would I be given an independent project?
Will I be given an independent project by you?

solution:
Here is the solution in the requested HTML format:

```html
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "Will you give me an independent project?"
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "me" at the beginning and change it to "I".
